sections.title: Location and Contact
sections.text:
Status: available

Clearbrook Eye Center is a fictional ophthalmology practice created for product demonstrations.

Harbor Point Center: 1840 Harbor Point Drive, Suite 220, Tampa, Florida 33607. This is the primary demo location for comprehensive ophthalmology, retina, uveitis, glaucoma, pediatric ophthalmology, strabismus, oculoplastics, routine vision, and optical services.

Cypress Commons Center: 620 Cypress Commons Way, Suite 140, Tampa, Florida 33612. This demo location represents comprehensive ophthalmology, cataract evaluation, glaucoma care, routine vision, and optical services.

Main demo phone: (802) 787-8312.
Administrative email for new-patient paperwork or requested documents: newpatients@clearbrookeye.example.
Demo fax: (813) 555-0194.

Use the administrative email only for new-patient paperwork or requested documents.

sections.title: Hours
sections.text:
Status: available

Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM Eastern Time. Closed Saturday and Sunday. Provider and optical schedules may differ.

sections.title: After Hours
sections.text:
Status: available

The fictional after-hours line is (813) 555-0199.

sections.title: Scope of Services
sections.text:
Status: available

Clearbrook provides medical and surgical eye evaluations for cataracts, glaucoma, retina conditions, uveitis, pediatric ophthalmology, adult strabismus, double vision, and oculoplastic or eyelid concerns. Retina evaluations are available, while retina surgery is performed at an affiliated surgical facility rather than in the office.

Clearbrook also provides routine eye examinations, glasses prescriptions, contact-lens prescriptions and fittings, and optical services. Routine optometry is represented for patients age 7 and older. Children under 7 needing routine vision care use the medical scheduling lane for pediatric ophthalmology.

sections.title: Providers
sections.text:
Status: available

All providers below are fictional demo providers:

- Doctor Elena Marlowe: comprehensive ophthalmology, cataract evaluation, and glaucoma care at Harbor Point and Cypress Commons.
- Doctor Julian Reyes: retina and uveitis care at Harbor Point.
- Doctor Camille Hart: pediatric ophthalmology, adult strabismus, and double-vision evaluation at Harbor Point on a limited rotating schedule.
- Doctor Jonah Ellis: comprehensive ophthalmology, glaucoma care, and oculoplastic or eyelid evaluation at Harbor Point.
- Doctor Nina Patel: routine vision, glasses prescriptions, and contact-lens fittings at both locations for eligible ages.
- Doctor Marcus Wynn: routine vision and medical optometry at Cypress Commons.

Provider availability, location, age eligibility, and clinical fit must come from current scheduling results or staff confirmation.

sections.title: Optical and Glasses
sections.text:
Status: available

Clearbrook's fictional optical department represents frames from YSL, Ferragamo, Gucci, Ray-Ban, Nike, Bebe, Anne Klein, Vivid, Lacoste, and Puma. Lens upgrades are available. Glasses usually take about 10 business days to arrive.

Eyeglass prescriptions are valid for 2 years, while a yearly eye exam is recommended. Patients may bring an outside prescription to shop for glasses. A routine eye examination is available for patients without a valid prescription.

Non-prescription sunglasses are represented in the demo and may be made with prescription lenses. Vision insurance generally does not cover non-prescription sunglasses.

Morgan Lee is the fictional licensed optician and is represented at Harbor Point Tuesday through Friday, 9:30 AM to 4:30 PM. No appointment is needed to browse frames, request adjustments, or ask about minor repairs.

Glasses pickup policy: a readiness text confirms glasses are ready for pickup; patients wait for that text before coming in. This policy does not establish an individual order's readiness.

sections.title: Contact Lenses
sections.text:
Status: available

Clearbrook offers contact-lens prescriptions and fittings through the routine-vision scheduling lane when the caller is using accepted vision coverage or self-pay.

sections.title: Repairs and Warranty
sections.text:
Status: available

Patients should bring glasses to Harbor Point or Cypress Commons. Staff reviews the item and determines repair or warranty options in person. A specific repair, replacement, cost, or warranty outcome remains unconfirmed until staff inspects the glasses.

sections.title: Insurance and Referrals
sections.text:
Status: available

The demo insurance files intentionally mirror the established ophthalmology coverage lists for demonstration. A successful participation match does not guarantee active eligibility, benefits, copays, deductibles, referral requirements, authorization, service coverage, provider network, or payment.

For routine-vision patients, some plans do not cover retinal photography and the fictional demo charge is $39.

Referral requirements are not supplied.

sections.title: Self-Pay Pricing
sections.text:
Status: available

New-patient medical visit with an optometrist: $150. Established-patient medical visit with an optometrist: $75. New-patient medical visit with an ophthalmologist: $250. Established-patient medical visit with an ophthalmologist: $125. Routine vision examination with an optometrist: $100. Routine vision with contact-lens fitting: $150.

These are fictional demo prices.

sections.title: What to Bring
sections.text:
Status: available

Bring photo identification, an insurance card when using insurance, a list of current medications, and previous eye records when available. Bring current glasses or contact-lens information when relevant.

sections.title: Appointment Expectations
sections.text:
Status: available

New-patient visits may take 1 to 2 hours. Eye dilation may occur and can cause temporary blurry vision and light sensitivity. Provider, location, visit length, and dilation remain subject to the booked appointment and clinical needs.
